thread:
sarah_sales: Quick ask — Acme's POC starts Monday and their load hits ~2.5B tokens/day for two weeks. Their workload will blow past our hosted tier caps. Can we temporarily override per-token pricing and waive the min charge for the POC?

alex_ae: Do we have an expected dollar run-rate? Need numbers to take to deal desk.

sarah_sales: Short calc below (ballpark):
```
2.5B tokens/day * 14 days = 35B tokens
current hosted list: $0.00004/token -> $1,400,000
suggested temporary tier: $0.000025/token -> $875,000
waive hosted min-charge (~$15k) for POC
```
They want this to be low-friction — no contract now, just a POC credit/override.

lisa_finance: Those are big swings. We need a cap and repayment path if they convert. Would accept a capped credit ($200k) + make them sign a follow-on intent form. Also need GL code and accounting note.

raj_deals: @lisa_finance +1 on cap. Alternative: offer a 30-day limited trial with a spend cap of $250k and a short MOU that says usage above cap will be billed at standard hosted rates unless they sign a committed Dedicated deal within 30 days. That shifts risk.

mike_ce: From engineering/POC side — they can't throttle easily, so a hard cap will break the demo. Can we do a soft-cap with alerts and an overage notification to their AM? We need the override by EOD to avoid delaying kickoff.

alex_ae: Proposed immediate path for approval: 1) Temporary pricing override to $0.000025/token for 14d, 2) Waive min-charge for POC, 3) Cap Redwood credit at $300k, 4) Require signed intent/LOI for committed follow-on within 45d or revert to list pricing.

lisa_finance: If deal desk ok, finance signs off on a formal credit memo that limits Redwood's exposure to $300k and includes recovery clause. Need the customer legal name and billing entity.

raj_deals: I'll route to deal desk now. Putting in request: DD-4521. Include the cost calc and cap.

ops-bot: A ticket has been created: #DD-4521 — Temporary PRICING_OVERRIDE request created by raj_deals. Approvers: lisa_finance, vp-sales.

sarah_sales: Customer info: Acme Cloud Inc (billing: Acme Cloud, LLC). Contact: mike@acme.com. They agreed to LOI if we provide POC runway.

mike_ce: We're good to proceed on our side once override is live. Will monitor and pause if anything spikes.

lisa_finance: Need one thing from you @sarah_sales — short note from the AE confirming the cap and intent terms that will be attached to the credit memo. After that I can sign.

sarah_sales: Sending note now, will post copy here. :thumbsup:

alex_ae: Thanks — if deal desk approves DD-4521 today, ops can apply a temporary rate override and create a one-off promo code tied to the account.

raj_deals: I'll follow up in the ticket and ping vp-sales.

sarah_sales: (posting AE note) "Acme agrees to POC terms: Redwood credit capped at $300k, 14-day POC at temporary rate $0.000025/token. Acme will provide decision intent within 45 days and engage commercial for committed capacity if moving to production."

lisa_finance: Good. I approve the credit memo draft pending vp-sales sign-off.

ops-bot: DD-4521 marked: awaiting vp-sales approval.

mike_ce: Awesome — I'll stand by to validate once override is applied.

alex_ae: Action items: raj -> escalate DD-4521; lisa -> sign credit memo once vp ok; sarah -> attach AE note to ticket; ops -> implement override if approved.

sarah_sales: thanks y'all — will report back when override is confirmed. :rocket:
